Claim 26 (Currently amended): A non-transitory machine readable medium storing a program which when executed by at least one processing unit analyzes a document, the program comprising sets of instructions for: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document, the document having a drawing order that indicates the order in which the primitive graphic elements are drawn when the document is displayed; calculating a first value for a first primitive graphic element and a second primitive graphic element that is subsequent to the first in the drawing order, the first value representing a size of the first primitive graphic element; and based on the comparison of the first value to other values calculated for additional primitive graphic elements that are subsequent in the drawing order, defining a single structural graphic element within the document from the first and second primitive graphic elements.

Claim 27 (Currently amended): The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the first value is a size value associated with the first primitive graphic element.

Claim 28 (Currently amended): The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the first value represents a size of a smallest bounding box that encompasses the first and second primitive graphic elements, the smallest bounding box being calculated as a function of both the width and height of the bounding box.

Claim 31 (Currently amended): The non-transitory machine readable medium of claim 26, wherein the set of instructions for calculating comprises a set of instructions for calculating a different value for each pair of primitive graphic elements subsequent in the drawing order, wherein the set of instructions for defining the single structural graphic element comprises sets of instructions for: using the calculated values for pairs of primitive graphic elements to identify clusters of primitive graphic elements as candidates for joining as compound graphic elements; identifying sequences of primitive graphic elements within a cluster whose bounding boxes intersect based on the calculated values; and joining the sequences as single graphic elements.

Claim 37 (Currently amended): A method for analyzing a document, the method comprising: receiving a document that comprises a plurality of primitive graphic elements defined separately within the document, the document having a drawing order that indicates the order in which the primitive graphic elements are drawn when the document is displayed; calculating a size value for a first primitive graphic element and a second primitive graphic element that is subsequent to the first in the drawing order; and based on the comparison of the size value to other values calculated for additional primitive graphic elements that are subsequent in the drawing order, defining a single structural graphic element within the document from the first and second primitive graphic elements.
